dogecoin.text:
Also to note, the SNL appearance was absolutely planned in as well, as a PR move but also to spur further divide between #dogecoin and #Bitcoin in a lead up to the attempted crash.

Divide and conquer is the oldest trick in the book.

Unfortunately, #Bitcoin #dogecoin and the cryptocurrency space, in general, is unregulated. So Elon has been able to utilize his following, a lot of which are people investing their life savings in an effort to protect themselves from a sinking economy and insane inflation.
